Case reference: 2014005921.CaseDesc: On June 19, 2012, at approximately noon, Diane Bonneau was seen for the last time at her residence in Saint-Félicien, Quebec. Diane hasn’t been seen and we haven’t heard from her since.

Case reference: 2014005302.CaseDesc: On November 11, 2005, in Toronto, Canada, Zaina Trujillo-Talib was abducted by her father, Chaudhry Talib and her paternal grandmother, Shama Talib.  Chaudhry and Shama immediately took six-year-old Zaina to their family home located in Lahore, Pakistan.  Since this time, Zaina's mother has not been allowed to have any contact with her daughter.

Case reference: 2018000324.CaseDesc: On October 6, 2006, Freda Whiteman was seen for the last time at the York Hotel in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014003833.CaseDesc: On September 27, 1975, Barry Kelly was seen for the last time at the Speak-Easy Steakhouse in Niagara Falls, New York, in the United States. He never returned to his Niagara Falls, Ontario, home. At the time of his disappearance, Barry was despondent, and he has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014006184.CaseDesc: On October 15, 1977, Jacques Chaput left the family home in Trois-Rivières, Quebec following a disagreement he had with his mother and he never returned. Numerous steps were taken by his family to locate him, but they were unsuccessful. Jacques was officially declared missing by his family in 2013.

Case reference: 2013000018.CaseDesc: On November 17th, 2010, Varaporn Toassami left Canada with her daughter, Chonticha Galamae Ellefson-Toassami in contravention of a family Court Order.  They travelled to Thailand, where it is believed they still are today.  Varaporn Toassami has been charged with child abduction under Section 282 of the Criminal Code.  There is a warrant for her arrest.

Case reference: 2009003699.CaseDesc: Michel Gagich, who typically goes by his middle name: Steve, was last seen by his father on Saturday, September 5, 2009 at his residence in Hamilton, Ontario.  He left his residence on Sunday, September 6, 2009 in the morning, around 8:00 a.m. without speaking to his parents.  He left a note indicating that he was leaving for the weekend. Michel's vehicle was located on Tuesday, September 8, 2009 at approximately 7:15 p.m. when a passing airplane observed a fire.  By the time the fire department arrived the vehicle was completely burned.  The vehicle was located in a remote area on Emmett Lake Road in St. Edmund's Township.  Michel was last seen at the Tobermory Ferry Terminal on Wednesday, September 9, 2009 at 7 a.m.  It is not known if he purchased a ticket to board the ferry.  The MS Chi Cheemaun ferry provides transportation for vehicles and people from Tobermory to South Baymouth on Manitoulin Island.

Hair: Brown, Short, Dark, receding hair line; Moustache, Sideburns

Case reference: 2019052572.CaseDesc: On January 1, 1995, Bojan Stamenkovic was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Following his arrival to Canada from Serbia, Bojan was employed as a mechanical engineer, and a professor at the University of Toronto. Around the time of his disappearance, Bojan had informed his family that he would not be able to contact them for an extended period of time due to unknown reasons.

Case reference: 1999003370.CaseDesc: Nancy Liou was last seen at home on January 27, 1999. On January 28, her father contacted Nancy's school to see if she was there, and was advised they had no way of knowing if she was in attendance as it was exam time. Her father contacted police that evening when she failed to return home from school.  She had advised a family member she was leaving but never said where she was headed.

Case reference: 2014003913.CaseDesc: Martin Maier was last seen on May 4, 1973, leaving the local hotel in Prelate, Saskatchewan at approximately 1:00 a.m. He was driving a red 1971 Chevrolet half-ton pick-up Saskatchewan license F133013 with a white camper on the cargo box.  Extensive searches have been conducted, however neither Martin or his vehicle have been located.

Case reference: 2014045101.CaseDesc: The partial remains of an older adult female were found near Chasm, British Colombia in 2010. She had no teeth in her lower jaw and had likely gone missing many years earlier.

Case reference: 2012020071.CaseDesc: Richard Tssessaze's last known place of residence was Brandon, Manitoba.  He had previously lived in Thompson and Lac Brochet.  He was last seen in the area around the St. Regis Hotel on Smith Street in downtown Winnipeg in late June 2009.  Richard has not been seen or heard from since that time, and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014003132.CaseDesc: On December 29, 1978, Sharon Drover was seen for the last time in downtown St. John's, Newfoundland & Labrador. Investigators believe Sharon intended to hitchhike home after her shift.

Case reference: 2018008230.CaseDesc: On September 1, 1993, Trevor Chase was seen for the last time by his relatives in Truro, Nova Scotia. Trevor’s family believed that he may have been residing in Vancouver, British Columbia, in 1994.

Case reference: 2012020080.CaseDesc: On July 9, 2004, at 11:30 p.m., Courtney Struble, 13 years old, was last seen walking towards her residence in Estevan, SK. There have been reported sightings of Courtney, however, despite investigations and searches, she has not been located.

Mark: Neck, birthmark at nape of neck

Case reference: 2005000899.CaseDesc: On April 21, 2005, a Caucasian male, believed to be between the ages of 29 and 50, was found in a wooded area on the embankment of a small creek off Queen Street in Bobcaygeon, Ontario. There are indications that this person suffered from early age-related osteoarthritis. It is believed that this individual had likely been at this location since 1994 or earlier.

Case reference: 2014002147.CaseDesc: On September 22, 1981, the Churchill RCMP received a call from Mrs. Esmoil, who said that her two sons and two friends were late returning from a canoe trip. On August 18 1981, Brian Dean Esmoil and his brother headed out on an extended canoe trip from Leaf Rapids to Churchill, Manitoba, with two friends. Numerous items belonging to the men were found on the shore. Three of the four travellers' bodies were recovered in the Churchill River, and the cause of death was determined to be drowning. Brian's body has never been found, and it is presumed that he also drowned.

Case reference: 2006013199.CaseDesc: Heather Moggy was last seen on June 22, 2002. She may be in the company of John Tucsok who has been affiliated with the "THE ASSEMBLY OF GOD" church. John is wanted by the police for offences in Ontario. Heather and John had a joint post office box together in Brantford, Ontario, until September 2003. A letter has been received post marked from Calgary, Alberta. The last contact from Heather to her family was by telephone, in October 2003, when she indicated that they may be going to Saskatchewan (Moose Jaw).  As of this date, all attempts to locate either subject have failed.

Case reference: 2014005585.CaseDesc: In December 2010, Amanda McLeod was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2006003399.CaseDesc: On November 2, 2001, this male, was found in a sewer at 470 Lansdowne Avenue in Toronto. His ancestry is Caucasian, possibly Egyptian or mixed African/Caucasian. He had previous surgery of his left forearm, which had involved the implant of surgical plates. The numbers visible on the surgical plates could not be traced to a specific individual, however, it was determined that the lot was released some time after May 25, 1994. A MacDonald’s name tag with the name "Raymond" was found in the sewer, which may or may not be related to this individual.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Hip, recent fracture of left hip

CCTV footage shows her at a nearby 7-Eleven at 02:55 a.m. Natanis has not been in contact with family since that time, which is highly unusual for her. Her disappearance is considered to be of a suspicious nature.

Lucie suffers from epilepsy and requires medication.

Case reference: 2014005961.CaseDesc: Chris Metallic was last seen in Sackville, New Brunswick, at around 3 a.m. on Sunday, November 25, 2012. Case reference: 2014002608.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1998, Jong Donohue was seen for the last time as he departed from Camrose, Alberta. It is possible that Jong may have had plans to travel to Vancouver, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014004872.CaseDesc: Andre Lemieux was last seen on January 9, 2007 in Montreal, Quebec. Andre brought his child to daycare that day and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2018043199.CaseDesc: In December of 1995, Myung Lim was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Myung and his wife had an argument and he told her he was returning to South Korea.

Case reference: 2014001428.CaseDesc: On May 19, 1998, at approximately 7:00 p.m., Rémi Engrand left a residence for men in Valleyfield, Quebec, for a walk with two other residents of the center where he had been staying for a few days. They went to the Delpha-Sauvé Park, where Rémi wanted to go swimming in the river, near the waterfall. The three separated, leaving Rémi alone and when they returned, they found Rémi’s clothes on the shoreline. The current in this section of the river is very fast and the presence of the falls makes swimming very risky. Rémi has not been seen since this time.

Case reference: 2025051011.CaseDesc: On September 15, 2025, Millicent Powell was reported missing to the Winnipeg Police Service. Her last known sighting was on July 18, 2025 in a rural area near Anola, Manitoba, to the east of Winnipeg.  She had confirmed that her current objective was to reach Toronto, Ontario.  Millicent adopted a transient lifestyle, is known for using housing resources for the homeless and suffers from schizophrenia and a brain trauma.

Case reference: 2014005093.CaseDesc: Hooshang Imanpoorsaid was last seen on May 2, 2008 from Brossard, Quebec, where he was living. Hooshang was reported missing by his family, and his credit card was used at the Dorval airport and later again in the Netherlands in 2008. Hooshang is originally of Iranian descent.

Case reference: 2018007415.CaseDesc: Scott Woodley was last seen on April 15, 2014 on Industrial Road in Cambridge, Ontario.  Scott lived a transient lifestyle and it is believed that he was living in a tent at the end of Industrial Road at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2024050951.CaseDesc: David Mitchell was last seen on September 9, 2024 in Whites Mountain, New Brunswick, when he was dropped off at work by a family member. On September 12, 2024, the same family member went back to pick David up, he was informed that David had left the premises to go to a bar on the same day he was dropped off and failed to return. Despite extensive efforts to contact him by mobile phone, there was no response. The telecommunications provider confirmed that the last activity on David's phone was on September 9. Furthermore, the bank has confirmed that his account has been inactive since September 8. Comprehensive investigations is ongoing but these efforts have not yet yielded results.

Case reference: 2006008299.CaseDesc: Richard Rollo jumped out of his boat into Muskrat Lake, near Gull Rock, Cobden, Ontario in 1997 and never resurfaced.  He is presumed drowned.

Shortly after leaving, Terry's Petro-Points card was used at the Albert South Petro Canada on a $26.00 purchase.

His canoe and personal belongings were located on the lake.

Case reference: 2006012299.CaseDesc: On June 02, 1984, Andrew Grinnell, his brother, their cousin and a friend departed Sioux Lookout on a canoe trip on the Albany River. The party arrived in Fort Albany on July 18, 1984. At 6:00 p.m. that same day, the party decided to leave Fort Albany in an attempt to paddle to Moosonee via James Bay. The group had planned to go out onto James Bay with the tide and sail to Moosonee by lashing their canoes together. An intense storm engulfed the James Bay coastal area on July 23, 1984, and it is likely that the party perished on the Bay during this storm. Three victims were recovered in August 1984, twelve nautical miles North of the Moose River. Andrew's body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2013000090.CaseDesc: On June 16, 1983, Nicola Michel Tola was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. He was suppose to come home and make dinner but he was never seen again by his family. His car was located at the Pie IX shopping mall.

Case reference: 2014001627.CaseDesc: On May 25, 1990, Robert Henson was seen for the last time riding his horse along the river in the Hummingbird Falls and Creek area in Rocky Mountain House, Alberta. While riding his horse, Robert was swept down the river.

Case reference: 2014002878.CaseDesc: On February 26, 2001, Albert Fare was seen for the last time as he left his residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Albert was despondent.

Scar: Neck, Surgical; back of the neck

Case reference: 2014001370.CaseDesc: Irene Godreau was reported missing on August 3, 2002 from the nursing home where she resided in Grand Falls, New Brunswick. Irene, who was 78 years old when she went missing, was last seen on the front porch of the nursing home at roughly 2:30 p.m. on August 3, 2002 and was not seen again. Irene has difficulty walking, which raised concerns for her safety and ability to travel far on her own. A thorough search of the surrounding area was performed but those efforts yielded no trace of her.

Case reference: 2007002399.CaseDesc: Marilyn Neely was last seen by a friend on September 18, 1983, driving Southbound on Goodfellow Road, in the county of Peterborough. Her vehicle, a 1975 Dodge Dart, was later found on the Five Point Trail access road approximately 11 km west of Hwy #507. That same day a woman matching her description was seen walking west along the road from that location.

Purse: Green, White, vinyl with a white shoulder strap

Case reference: 2014002495.CaseDesc: Linda Scott was reported missing to the Edmonton Police Service in April 2000. Linda was last heard from by a family member in March 2000. She is normally in contact with family at least once a week. Linda was believed to be last seen with friends.

Case reference: 2020008724.CaseDesc: On September 20, 1979, Irvin Lasinskas was last seen at the Wellesley Hospital in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Irvin was despondent.

Case reference: 2012020088.CaseDesc: Norbert Couillonneur was last seen on May 27, 2010, at Pinehouse Lake, Saskatchewan, wearing blue jeans and a light blue T-shirt. He is known to travel regularly between Pinehouse Lake and Canoe Lake, SK.
